$flatten: Inline JS that drops the viewport-height lock on html/body/.app-shell so puppeteer's fullPage screenshot can extend past the 720px viewport.

tests.name: Marketplace — overview (full page)

actions.value: for (const el of [document.documentElement, document.body, document.querySelector('.app-shell'), document.querySelector('.layout'), document.querySelector('.content'), document.querySelector('.app-main'), document.querySelector('main')]) { if (el) { el.style.height = 'auto'; el.style.maxHeight = 'none'; el.style.minHeight = '0'; el.style.overflow = 'visible'; } } true;

tests.expect: Full Marketplace page top-to-bottom — header, legacy banner, populated stats (14 Total · 9 Installed · 3 Active), tab strip, search, theme cards (CRT Terminal, Midnight Gold, Arctic Light, …).
